$comment: Valley modifiers, chosen at the Turning. The valley already re-rolls after every ceremony and always granted nothing for it; choosing how the next one differs is what turns that loss into a step forward. `unlockLevel` gates each one, so there is something still to come at level twenty. What each one DOES lives in modifiers.js — an effect is logic, not data.

modifiers.name: Thin Woods
modifiers.hint: Fewer trees. You can see a long way, and so can they.

modifiers.name: Night Valley
modifiers.hint: Dark the whole way. The orbs are easier to spot, the ground is not.

modifiers.name: Fierce Camps
modifiers.hint: Quicker hands than usual, and they pay for it.
